answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 860 fakes pays 573 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The crystal keeps the gate honest, the oasis keeps the farm poor, and the ripple keeps the honest agent paid.
